changelog:
- Initial release of TikTok Live stream monitoring and recording automation.
- Uses Playwright for visual detection of live status and to extract FLV stream URLs from network traffic.
- Automatically checks if a TikTok user is live and records streams to disk.
- Includes notification system for live/offline status changes.
- Provides CLI scripts to check live status and obtain stream URLs.
